newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal shines with year high.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal shines with year high.

text.p: French beauty products group L'Oreal gained more than 2.5 percent on Friday and hit a year-high of 1,842 francs at 1154 GMT with dealers and analysts divided over the reasons for the rise.
The blue-chip index, meanwhile, was up 0.84 percent at the same time.

A spokeswoman for the company confirmed that the company had an investor road show in Geneva this afternoon. On Monday L'Oreal reported a 12.2 percent nine-month sales rise to 44.6 billion francs. But the spokeswoman declined to comment on the share price development.
Volume in L'Oreal was an average 44,377 shares.

Traders did not know a specific reason for the rise. "There is neither speculation, nor any particular rumour this morning," one said. Another suggested the share was catching up after a recent under-performance.
A third noted that there were many basket trades in CAC-40 stocks on Friday morning.
"L'Oreal has the heaviest weighting in the index, the share is therefore in all buy baskets. That explains the rise this morning," he added.
Another dealer noted good fundamentals for the group.
